name: Boattail Sign-Convention Test
source: Synthetic — textbook case for boattail destabilization
description: A simple rocket with a conical boattail (reducing tail diameter). The boattail adds NEGATIVE C_Nα with CP aft, which moves the overall CP FORWARD (destabilizing). This test catches the most common sign error in transition/boattail aero: getting the sign backwards makes boattails appear stabilizing.

reference_data.assertion: CP with boattail must be FORWARD of CP without boattail (by 0.1-0.5 calibers)
